reachability.note: alphaarcade.com 302 -> www.alphaarcade.com which returns 403 Cloudflare challenge to non-browser clients. Passes via real browser (Playwright). Site loads as React SPA on www.alphaarcade.com.

1.1_llms_txt.details: alphaarcade.com/llms.txt returns HTTP error. docs.alphaarcade.com does not exist (ECONNREFUSED). No llms.txt available.

1.2_markdown_negotiation.details: Accept: text/markdown header returns 403 Cloudflare challenge. No markdown content negotiation supported.

1.3_structured_metadata.details: Has meta description ('Predict sports, crypto, politics & more. 100% of trading fees go to $ALPHA holders.'), og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type, og:site_name, og:locale. No JSON-LD.

2.1_content_without_js.details: React SPA with #root container. No SSR/prerendering detected. Cloudflare challenge blocks curl entirely (403). Without JS execution, no content is accessible.

2.2_semantic_html.details: Uses nav (1), main (1), header (1), footer (1) = 4 semantic HTML elements. Meets 3+ threshold.

2.4_sitemap_xml.details: Valid sitemap.xml at /sitemap.xml with 100+ URLs covering homepage, markets, how-it-works, whitepaper, leaderboard, privacy-policy, terms-of-use, and individual market pages.

2.5_proper_404s.details: /this-does-not-exist-xyz123 returns 200 with full homepage content. No 404 status code, no 'not found' message. SPA catch-all renders homepage for unknown routes.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.details: No developer documentation found. docs.alphaarcade.com does not resolve (ECONNREFUSED). No /docs path. Only user-facing pages: /how-it-works, /whitepaper.

3.2_docs_findable.details: No documentation links found in navigation or footer. Footer has only social links (X, Discord, Telegram) and legal pages (Terms, Privacy).

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.details: No REST API, SDK, or MCP server documentation found. No developer-facing programmatic interface documented anywhere on the site.

3.4_standard_navigation.details: 102 standard <a href> links on homepage. Navigation includes Build a Parlay, How it works, market links, category links, footer social/legal links.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.details: robots.txt: User-agent: * / Disallow: (empty) / Sitemap: https://www.alphaarcade.com/sitemap.xml. All crawlers including AI bots explicitly allowed.

4.2_no_captcha.details: Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge) blocks all non-browser HTTP clients with 403. Effectively acts as a CAPTCHA/bot gate for programmatic access.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.details: No MCP server, agent guide, or bot policy found. No developer or agent-facing documentation exists.

summary: Alpha Arcade scores D (6/15). The site has decent basic web standards (semantic HTML, sitemap, readable URLs, OG metadata, permissive robots.txt) but is severely limited for AI agent access. The Cloudflare challenge blocks all non-browser clients with 403, the React SPA renders nothing without JavaScript, there are no developer docs or API documentation, no llms.txt, no proper 404 handling, and no agent-facing resources (MCP, SDK, bot policy). The site is built for human browser users only.
